result:
The decisions playground is now served at `/ml-inference/playground` instead of `/ml-inference/decisions`. I did not run any tests or the app.

I changed two places, both in the frontend:
- `products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx`: the scene route and the `urls.decisionPlayground()` helper.
- `frontend/src/products.tsx`: the same two entries. This file is the generated aggregate of the product manifests, so I edited it by hand to match rather than regenerating it.

Links and navigation go through `urls.decisionPlayground()`, so they pick up the new address. The Storybook story does this too, and a repo-wide search found no other references to the old path. The page's behavior and content are unchanged.

I left the backend API endpoint at `ml_inference/decisions`. That is an API resource path rather than the page address, and renaming it would change generated clients for no user-facing benefit.

I did not add a redirect from the old address, so any bookmark to `/ml-inference/decisions` will no longer open the page.
